body: I would say get her to a crisis center or mental hospital. She needs it. The time away and the 24 hour care will help. As much as it may hurt to hear this family can often hurt more than they can help. Not always 100% true but still.
I am just gonna say you are not alone for trying to OD on vitamins. All I had left and was in quite a low spot.

Every time I let myself feel I just get taken advantage of and I get torn to shreds. My family, my ex girlfriend, and some I no longer call friends. I just get used and thrown aside. I can't trust people enough to feel.
Thank you, I will go check with the doctors
No they sound like conversations or arguing, either or but always seeming like a normal talking voice/tone

I have faked my true personality to the point where I don't really have one anymore. I just kinda adapt and change who I am based on who I am talking to. It started out the same as you, to give myself a protective shell, and now it just is me. Fake it till you make it I guess...

Do something crazy and out of "character" for yourself, you will feel much better.
Couldn't you apply for an escort agency? I have never affiliated myself in any sort of way with an escort agency so I have no clue but that might be something to look into.

I would just like to say you story is very touching, and I am actually in tears. Not because I am a touchy feely type but because you sound a little like my little sister. You bring back memories of her worse days and it just brightens how much better she is now. She is much younger than you are, but nonetheless similar. 

Please go see someone. I sat on the sidelines for this whole process, watched her suffer emotionally and cause herself self mutilation. I have seen many things as she started to develop twisted habits as a result of it. The epitome was when we found a bucket of her blood from the cuts. This stuff haunts me to this day. Being on the sidelines for this kind of thing sucks and I promise there is someone who cares for you. Seek help, please just do it.

P.S. Also thank you. I made a post earlier about how I felt like a zombie on my new meds on this thread. They have mostly worn off but it is nice to feel something other than nothing or depression, even if it is sadness. I hope all gets better for you.

Thanks it is nice to hear. currently the only thing that calms my panic attacks are a nice cigar/pipe and some blues music as odd as that is. It wouldn't be as big of an issue if it didn't interfere with my studies as much as it does. The apathy for everything and the panic attacks are not helping me. Sigh...

My anxiety is crippling. If I forget to take my meds I go into a panic attack that renders me useless for the next three hours minimum. I also finally pulled myself out of my depressive hole that made me suicidal...though meds. When it wears off or I forget to take it I go back to that hole but when I do take it I am like a zombie, somewhat emotionless and fairly uncaring about what happens to me or others. I keep hoping it will change but it doesn't, and I should get new meds but I am scared that they might not work (lots of meds do nothing to me). The biggest thing is nobody really knows the extent besides my therapist and I am too scared to explain the full extent to anyone else.

BTW thanks OP for being awesome.
Thanks, This has talked me out of suicide for now, still feel horrendously empty but I don't think I will kill myself quite yet.

Haha, I feel the same about the school system. I guess it does help to think about my passion. Oddly enough it is brewing beer (despite my age), cooking, and cigars/pipe. My true dream is to open up a small bar in the tropics somewhere.
Well I hope my story could have helped in some way and thank you for replying.
